data.title: 西连寺春菜 · 暖光卧室的拘谨凝视
data.action: 并膝端坐在松软床铺中央，双手平按在大腿上，上衣领口微偏，含羞仰望
data.lighting: 床头暖橙色小夜灯在柔顺棉被上投下的温暖对角线阴影
data.location: 春菜温馨私密的少女卧室浅粉色床铺中央
data.description: 深夜闺房内，床头暖灯洒下一圈柔和温热的橙黄光晕。春菜并膝拘谨地坐在整洁床铺上，双掌按在膝前，领口微偏露出小巧锁骨。她眼中泛着温柔的羞涩水光，静静仰望着走近的心上人。
data.promptProse: Sitting neatly with knees together in the center of her soft pink bed at night, Haruna Sairenji rests both palms on her lap in relaxed pale-yellow cotton short-sleeved pajamas and shorts whose loose neckline slips gently off one bare shoulder. Looking up with a tender, shy blush, she is warmed by amber bedside lamplight.
data.nsfwProse: She wears soft pale-yellow short-sleeved cotton pajamas whose loose collar slips casually off one bare shoulder above matching pajama shorts and bare feet.
data.animaCaption: Seated neatly barefoot with knees together and both palms resting on her lap across soft pink bedsheets, she gazes up with a shy rosy blush as her loose pale-yellow cotton pajama collar slips off one shoulder. Warm amber light from the bedside lamp casts gentle diagonal shadows.
